comment: Registry of installable Orbit patcher versions. ONE source of truth for the 'Previous versions' picker. Each entry pairs an archived patcher (patchers/<file>) with the Claude Code version it is verified against (claude) — that pin is what an install re-installs, so every pick is a known-good (patcher, Claude) pair. Newest entry last. Maintained by tools/archive_patcher.py; do not hand-edit unless you know the format.

patchers.notes: queue keyed by live session object (kill cross-chat + fork bleed)
floating preview bar — fade bottom + hide fork row (pinned only)
add Glow Default theme (Glow animation on default colors)
Glow themes — twirling AI-gradient composer border + restored selected-chat glow
Glow themes — soften selected-chat glow ring (less fierce)
restore real fork routing + lift rewind dialogs above session pane
fork fallback opens real forked session id in editor tab if same-pane activation misses
remove custom fork wrapper; leave Claude built-in fork behavior stock
fork buttons call Claude native handlers with shielded button click events
preserve native binary exec bit on re-zip (fixes macOS/Linux 'native binary exists but failed to launch'); guard refuses to ship a non-executable binary
red status dot for hard usage/rate-limit stops (rateLimitWarning); verified against Claude Code 2.1.161

queue flush is now per-session (Map<session,wasBusy>) and sends to each item's OWN session — fixes queued messages stranded forever when you switch chats or run multiple busy chats; the old single global busy-edge detector could only track one session at a time

session recency ordering (newest-to-top via local touchedAt); theme-independent selected-chat indicator on ALL themes (foreground left notch + static outline + bold name, no longer the blue bar that vanished on a blue chat); visible row hover on default + non-Glow themes (key off --vscode-list-hoverBackground instead of the near-invisible app token)

compact confirmation — the native 'context used · click to compact' button now opens an 'Are you sure?' dialog (reusing the existing confirm-overlay primitive) instead of compacting the instant it's touched; compact runs only on confirm. Non-fatal interception. Carries forward 1.2.74's selection notch/outline + hover fixes

re-certify for Claude Code 2.1.163. Claude's minifier renamed the session-row event-handler arrow param (M -> C), which broke the hard-coded OR0 status-insert + sessionMeta hover-action anchors ('Lost OR0 ... anchor'). Made those 5 arrow params match any identifier (backward-compatible with 2.1.162). Carries 1.2.74 selection/hover + 1.2.75 compact-confirm. Full patch verified against stock 2.1.163: node --check + all 86 gate checks pass
